instructions:
PUT each part: use the full upload_url verbatim (including its query string). Send only the raw part bytes as the body.

Example (one local file = one part):
  curl -fS -X PUT -T /path/to/file.ext '<paste upload_url here>'

Do NOT add HTTP headers like x-amz-checksum-crc32 or x-amz-sdk-checksum-algorithm (even if tutorials suggest them for AWS multipart). Do NOT strip checksum params from the URL and re-send them as headers. Then call upload_asset_complete with upload_id.
